summary: Ten-metre loading-zone and taxi-zone kerb on Moggill Road, too short for a van.
reasons: Only 10 m, under a van length

drivers.seclusion: Shopfront 4 m behind the footpath with a street tree; fully in view of the high street.
drivers.access_and_room: Stretch is 10 m with a bus stop and taxi zone alongside; no room to fit a van clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Loading zone, no stopping 4-7pm weekdays and a taxi zone at other times; not a place to sleep.

flags: Loading zone, no stopping and taxi zone signed
sun_shade: Street tree shades the western half; open to the south sun.
